current_request_policy.order: both channel histories filtered to each channel's requested language pair, sorted oldest first, keep newest five
current_request_policy.validity: age strictly less than60s, source/target language match or empty, text length at least2
current_request_policy.legacy_query_scope: These are not the current request resolver's integrated60s/five-entry path. The resolver inspected here calls integrated selection directly; the integrated_context_enabled boolean is not a branch in that method.

frozen_primary_workload.representation: five fixed synthetic labelled history contents, oldest first, with current public prompt and current build_translation_user_message wrapper; label-only context lines omit the real resolver's bullet/quote punctuation
frozen_primary_workload.performance_turn_variation: Step <request_index>: inserted in first self history line to avoid full-user-prompt exact cache hits
frozen_primary_workload.scope: Controlled representative history, not claimed byte-identical application history. All old/new primary arms share exactly this frozen representation.

literal_confirmation.representation: same five contents and Step marker passed through real ContextResolver/ChannelRuntime, correct self/opposite-peer pair identities, real bullets/quotes
literal_confirmation.filter_sanity: Synthetic wrong-pair and61s-old entries included before valid history; real resolver must exclude both and retain exactly five valid entries
literal_confirmation.scope: No tuning; paired old/new default/cache0 confirmations on each backend. Separate data phase literal; never pooled into earlier controlled-history timings.

actual_app.history: Unmodified real pipeline/resolver;30 same-pair synthetic warm turns fill the real five-entry context, followed by fresh-process restarts
actual_app.scene: synthetic empty process discovery; no scene participant metadata
actual_app.sampling: Current app temperature0.6, no caller seed override; native default random seed. App and seed42 standalone measurements are not pooled.
